independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/a20-bilingual-shell.spec.ts, e2e/support/qa-stack.sh and docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). This verdict comes from qa-verifier's own runs on a disposable clone of e37f6ea4 under $TMPDIR. It was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-4 record.

summary: PASS. Both round-3 findings verify CLOSED on candidate 29ced0ed in EN and AR on the real stack, in two runs. F-DG2-210: every claimed P2 form refuses whitespace- and invisible-only text inline, with the localized message, aria-invalid and focus, and sends and writes nothing. Visible text is stored verbatim. F-DG2-211: the banner is div[role=alert] > ul, and axe is clean in every error state. All static checks, integration (465 x2), contract (161 ops), blank-text, the DB guards, the QA regression suites and the e2e journeys (62 x2, including Define→G2 and Design→G3) pass, with no regression. One new Low, non-mandatory finding: F-DG2-220, a timing flake in the new web unit file p2-blank-forms.test.tsx that failed the Node 24 'pnpm test' once in 7 runs. Environmental residuals D-057, D-058 and D-049 are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface. All data is synthetic; no business approval is implied, and product G1–G6 never imply DG7.
